name: Kindful
description: Kindful is a nonprofit CRM and fundraising platform for managing supporters, donations, campaigns, funds, groups, custom fields and reporting.
agentUseSummary: Connect one Kindful organization through Relay-owned reviewed OAuth, then let selected agents read organization metadata and query authorized contacts and transactions through nine pinned provider routes. Relay requests only basic and data_query and does not mount imports, links or integration-status writes in V1.

capabilities.label: Read nonprofit CRM data
capabilities.description: Read account, campaign, fund, group and custom-field metadata and query contacts and transactions.

allowed.label: Read Kindful fundraising data
allowed.description: Read organization metadata and query authorized contacts and transactions through Kindful's documented API.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: All nine selected Kindful operations are semantic reads under basic and data_query; imports, links and integration-status writes are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same read-only surface runs without per-action approval; OAuth scopes, fixed routes, payload bounds, audits and provider limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts nine pinned Kindful metadata/query operations and attaches the encrypted OAuth token only to app.kindful.com.
Relay mounts nine pinned Kindful metadata/query operations and attaches the encrypted OAuth token only to app.kindful.com.

providerSetup.blocker: Kindful requires a Partner Dashboard application, OAuth client credentials, playground acceptance, provider QA and App Directory approval; this code-only worker has none of those artifacts.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the separate authorized provider-console task, create the Relay application with the exact Railway callback, request only basic and data_query, complete Kindful QA, store KINDFUL_CLIENT_ID and KINDFUL_CLIENT_SECRET on Railway, and validate consent, organization binding, every pinned metadata/query route, disconnect and post-disconnect denial in staging.

evidence.supports: Kindful documents its production authorization and token endpoints plus basic, data_add and data_query scopes; Relay deliberately selects only basic and data_query.
Kindful requires partner applications to use OAuth2, pass provider QA, comply with API terms and limit Kindful data use to the integration's function.
Kindful documents POST /api/v1/contacts/query, its linked/change/filter query language, maximum page size of fifty and five-minute query tokens.
Kindful documents POST /api/v1/transactions/query with linked/change/date/campaign filters and bounded query-token pagination.
Kindful documents organization details, campaigns, funds, groups and custom-field metadata as the supporting read surface for integrations.
